name: Delney, Streetwise Lookout doubles Orcish Bowmasters's triggered ability

prerequisites.timing: Whenever Orcish Bowmasters's compound trigger would fire: on it entering the battlefield, or on an opponent drawing a card except the first one they draw in their draw step.
targets_required: Each independent instance of the doubled trigger needs its own 'any target' choice for the 1 damage - both instances may target the same or different objects/players.
other: Orcish Bowmasters's power is 1 (printed base power), so it qualifies for Delney's power-2-or-less doubling clause.

Orcish Bowmasters's oracle text: 'Flash. When this creature enters and whenever an opponent draws a card except the first one they draw in each of their draw steps, this creature deals 1 damage to any target. Then amass Orcs 1.' - a single compound triggered ability (an OrTriggeredAbility covering both trigger conditions) with a targeted damage effect and an Amass effect.

Amass (CR 701.47a): 'If you don't control an Army creature, create a 0/0 black [subtype] Army creature token. Choose an Army creature you control. Put N +1/+1 counters on that creature.' Because the first triggered instance creates the Army token, the second instance (resolving afterward) finds a controlled Army already exists and simply adds its counters to the same token, rather than creating a second one - this is a rules-driven detail, not an assumption.

Power can change from other effects elsewhere in the deck (e.g. -1/-1 counters, boosts) which could push Orcish Bowmasters above power 2 and disqualify it from Delney's clause at the moment of a later trigger - not exhaustively checked against every other card's interaction with this power threshold, but not required for the base case verified here.

MODELING REQUIREMENT for future Layer 5 (Simulation) encoding, per docs/ARCHITECTURE.md Layer 2: do not collapse this into an atomic 'deal 2 damage to any target(s); amass 2' effect. Delney creates two genuinely independent instances of Orcish Bowmasters' entire triggered ability, each with its own 'any target' choice and each resolving Amass Orcs 1 separately (CR 603.3b governs the explicit ordering choice between the two pending instances). GBS-0004's recorded result (both instances targeted the same player, 2 total damage) is one valid outcome of that decision tree, not a reduction of it - a policy layer must be able to target the two instances independently (e.g. split damage across two different permanents/players) and see the trigger-ordering choice as a real decision point.

result.summary: Orcish Bowmasters' ETB/opponent-draw ping-and-amass trigger fires twice per qualifying event: 2 damage (split or concentrated across the two independently-targeted instances) and Amass Orcs 2 total (as +1/+1 counters on a single Army token) instead of 1 damage and Amass Orcs 1.

rules_citations: CR 603.2d — an ability may state that a triggered ability triggers additional times; determine how many times, then trigger that many times. This is the mechanic Delney's static ability relies on.

CR 603.3b — when multiple triggered abilities a player controls are waiting to be put on the stack, that player puts them on the stack in any order they choose (APNAP order). This governs the explicit trigger-ordering choice exercised when Delney creates two simultaneously-pending instances of Orcish Bowmasters' trigger.

CR 701.47a — to amass [subtype] N means to create a 0/0 Army token only if the player doesn't already control one, then put N +1/+1 counters on an Army they control. This is why the second doubled instance adds counters to the same Army token the first instance created, rather than creating a second token.

executable_engine_check.notes: Reproduced in the same from-source Maven build of magefree/mage (JDK 21) used for INT-0002/INT-0013, via a new JUnit test, org.mage.test.cards.interactions.cedh.DelneyOrcishBowmastersDoubleTest#test_DelneyDoublesOrcishBowmastersETB (not committed to this repo — see docs/RUN_CLASSIFICATION.md and rules_tests/gold_board_states/GBS-0004.json for the fixture record). Test setup: Delney, Streetwise Lookout + 2 Swamp on the battlefield for playerA, Orcish Bowmasters in hand. Cast Orcish Bowmasters (it has Flash) to genuinely trigger 'enters the battlefield' (fixture-placed battlefield cards don't fire ETB triggers in this framework). Two independent trigger instances appeared, requiring one trigger-order choice (the second instance auto-resolves once it's the only one remaining) and one 'any target' choice each, both targeted at playerB. Result: playerB's life dropped from 20 to 18 (2 damage total), and playerA controlled exactly one 'Orc Army Token' carrying 2 +1/+1 counters (not two separate tokens). Passed 1/1 on the second attempt (first attempt failed with a 'Missing CHOICE def' error for the trigger-ordering decision, which strict-choose mode requires explicitly even when both pending triggers are identical; fixed by adding setChoice(playerA, "Orcish Bowmasters")).

sources.reference: Independent pairwise scan of card_cache oracle text against Delney's triggered-ability-doubling clause, 2026-08-12 (not indexed as a formal combo by Commander Spellbook - this is a value multiplier, not a win line).
